result.reason: The Deliverable assignment and Customer Data ownership reach the preferred position, and Vendor Technology remains with Vendor. However, the operative language does not establish that the licence to embedded or required Vendor Technology is irrevocable and royalty-free; it merely references an unseen Section 13.2 and describes that licence only as perpetual. It also does not expressly cover work product outside the defined term “Deliverable.” The margin comment cannot cure these omissions. The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve unrelated commercial terms, but the incomplete cross-reference-based licence materially reduces drafting quality.
